# Keep MIME output defaults distinct from the requested output route

Entry 915 initializes mime_stream_data.format_out to zero. The accepted factory later assigns the requested nsMimeOutputType to both the stream data and MimeDisplayOptions. The zero default protects construction; it does not define every operation’s intended output mode. Preserve the paired assignment when changing factory setup. No meaning is inferred for enum value zero without checking the enum definition, and no MIME conversion test ran.

Scope: mailnews/mime/src.
